blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/ .
blocks.zh: 支气管镜检查手术前规划对于肺损伤的诊断至关重要. 目前的无障碍评估依赖于对CT扫描的主观人工检查,这很耗时,容易发生观测器之间的变异. 在本文中,我们将支气管镜学无障碍性预测正式化,作为新型的有监督的学习任务,并提出了第一个解决这一问题的端对端框架. 我们提出一个解剖学-人工智能混合实验(MoE)模型,该模型融合了专门模块:一个CT本地形态特征专家,一个Lobe解剖学前科专家,以及一个路径几何专家,该模型编码了支气管树的顺序约束. 为了支持这一任务,我们整理了第一个438个病例的临床数据集,其中包含手术前的CT扫描和记录的程序结果. 实验结果表明,我们的方法实现了0.8052的AUROC,大大超过了最新基线和经验丰富的人类专家。 这项工作为计算机辅助的肺医学干预规划确定了一个新的基准。 我们的数据和代码将在https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/上公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Bronchoscopy is widely used for the diagnosis of pulmonary lesions.
Although modern navigation systems assist intra-procedural guidance [ 6 , 12 ] , pre-operative accessibility assessment remains largely subjective. As demonstrated in our benchmark, expert bronchoscopists predict a diagnostic procedure with an AUROC of only 0.5661. This performance highlights the intrinsic difficulty of the task.
blocks.zh:
胸镜检查被广泛用于肺损伤的诊断.
虽然现代导航系统协助程序内部的引导[6,12],但操作前的无障碍评估大体上仍然是主观的. 正如我们的基准所示,支气管校正专家预测诊断程序,AUROC只有0.5661。 这一业绩突出了任务固有的困难。

blocks.en: Despite its clinical relevance, bronchoscopy accessibility prediction remains underexplored. Prior work has focused on airway segmentation [ 23 , 25 , 26 ] , lesion detection [ 19 ] , or path planning [ 5 ] . While these tasks provide an important basis, they do not directly address procedural accessibility. Existing attempts at outcome prediction rely on handcrafted geometric descriptors and statistical association models without end-to-end supervision [ 18 ] , failing to capture nonlinear interactions between local morphology, anatomical location, and airway complexity. A standardized benchmark for this task is also absent.
blocks.zh: 尽管与临床相关,支气管镜学无障碍性预测仍然没有得到充分利用。 先前的工作侧重于空中航道隔断[23、25、26]、损伤检测[19]或路径规划[5]。 虽然这些任务提供了重要的基础,但并不直接涉及程序无障碍。 现有的结果预测尝试依赖于手动几何描述符和统计关联模型,没有端到端监督[18],未能捕捉到当地形态学,解剖位置,和气道复杂性之间的非线性相互作用. 这项工作也没有标准化基准。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we first formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a supervised learning task and curate the first dataset dedicated to this problem. We retrospectively collected 438 clinically verified cases from three medical centers, each with documented procedural outcomes following bronchoscopy for lung lesions. This multi-center cohort provides diverse anatomical variability and realistic clinical distributions.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先将支气管镜学无障碍预测正式化,作为监督学习的任务,并整理了第一个专门处理该问题的数据集。 我们追溯性地从三个医疗中心收集了438个经临床核实的病例,每个中心都有记录的肺损伤支气管检查后的程序结果。 这个多中心组群提供了不同的解剖变异性和现实的临床分布.

blocks.en: Building upon this task definition, we propose an anatomy-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) [ 20 ] framework that decomposes accessibility prediction into three components. The CT Expert captures local volumetric context around the lesion. The Lobe Expert encodes anatomical priors reflecting regional variations. The Path Geometry Expert models cumulative geometric constraints along the airway trajectory. These representations are adaptively fused through a gating mechanism that performs case-dependent expert weighting.
blocks.zh: 基于这一任务定义,我们提出一个解剖学认识的专家混合[20]框架,将无障碍预测分为三个组成部分。 CT专家围绕病情捕捉局部体积环境. Lobe专家编码了反映区域变化的解剖学前科。 路径几何专家模型沿气道轨迹累积几何限制. 这些陈述通过一个进行个案专家加权的配对机制,以适应性的方式结合在一起。

blocks.en: To enable systematic evaluation, we further establish the first comprehensive benchmark for bronchoscopy accessibility prediction. The benchmark includes traditional machine learning methods, CT-based deep networks, graph neural networks, and human expert assessment. This benchmark provides a unified evaluation framework for future research on data-driven procedural planning.
blocks.zh: 为了能够进行系统评价,我们进一步建立了第一个综合基准,用于支气管镜检查无障碍性预测。 基准包括传统机器学习方法,基于CT的深层网络,图神经网络,以及人类专家评估. 这一基准为今后研究数据驱动的程序规划提供了一个统一的评价框架。

blocks.en: Our contributions are three-fold: 1. To address this severely under-studied clinical challenge, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as an end-to-end supervised deep learning task. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first deep learning application dedicated to predicting functional procedural outcomes directly from pre-operative CT scans. 2. We introduce an anatomy-aware MoE architecture that integrates volumetric imaging, anatomical priors, and airway geometry within a unified model. 3. We establish the first comprehensive benchmark for bronchoscopy accessibility prediction using 438 clinically verified cases and evaluate our framework against diverse computational baselines and human expert assessments.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 为了应对这一研究严重不足的临床挑战,我们正式确定支气管镜检查无障碍性预测为一项端到端监督的深层学习任务。 就我们所知,这项工作提出了第一个深入学习的应用程序,专门通过操作前的CT扫描直接预测功能程序结果。 2. 我们采用解剖学-认识的MOE架构,将体积成像、解剖学前科和气道几何综合在一个统一的模型中。 3. 我们利用438个经临床核实的病例,为支气管镜检查无障碍性预测制定第一个全面基准,并根据不同的计算基线和人类专家评估,评估我们的框架。

blocks.en: To address this severely under-studied clinical challenge, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as an end-to-end supervised deep learning task. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first deep learning application dedicated to predicting functional procedural outcomes directly from pre-operative CT scans.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一研究严重不足的临床挑战,我们正式将支气管镜学无障碍性预测作为一项端到端监督的深层学习任务. 就我们所知,这项工作提出了第一个深入学习的应用程序,专门通过操作前的CT扫描直接预测功能程序结果。

blocks.en: We introduce an anatomy-aware MoE architecture that integrates volumetric imaging, anatomical priors, and airway geometry within a unified model.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了解剖学认识的MOE架构,将体积成像,解剖学前科,气道几何学整合在一个统一的模型中.

blocks.en: We establish the first comprehensive benchmark for bronchoscopy accessibility prediction using 438 clinically verified cases and evaluate our framework against diverse computational baselines and human expert assessments.
blocks.zh: 我们利用438个经临床核实的病例,为支气管镜检查无障碍性预测制定了第一个全面基准,并根据不同的计算基线和人类专家评估,评估我们的框架。

blocks.en: 2.1 Expert Modules
blocks.zh: 2.1 专家单元

blocks.en: CT Expert
blocks.zh: CT专家

blocks.en:
The local structural relationship between the target lesion and the surrounding airway tree plays a central role in bronchoscopy accessibility.
CT Expert is formulated to capture the local morphological and spatial relationship between the target lesion and its surrounding airway structures.
blocks.zh:
目标损伤与周围气道树之间的局部结构关系,在支气管镜检查无障碍方面起着中心作用.
CT 翻译 专家的培养是为了了解目标损害与其周围空中结构之间的局部形态和空间关系。

blocks.en: We extract a multi-channel 3D patch x x comprising the raw CT intensities, a binary lesion mask, and a 3D Euclidean Distance Transform (EDT) [ 17 ] of the airway. The lesions are first automatically detected and subsequently verified to ensure consistency with the procedural target. The EDT provides continuous spatial gradients that stabilize learning compared to sparse airway masks. In this way, the model receives an explicit geometric prior reflecting airway accessibility rather than relying solely on implicit learning from intensity patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们提取一个多通道的3D补丁xx,包括原始的CT强度,二进制损伤口罩,以及空中3D Euclidean远程变形(EDT)[17]. 损害首先被自动发现,随后得到核实,以确保与程序目标保持一致。 与稀疏的空中遮罩相比,EDT提供了稳定学习的连续空间梯度. 这样,该模型就得到一个清晰的几何型号,先反映空气通道的可获取性,而不是仅仅依靠从强度模式中隐含的学习.

blocks.en: The multi-channel patch is processed by a custom 3D convolutional encoder. It consists of 4 consecutive residual blocks [ 8 ] integrated with squeeze-and-excitation (SE) [ 10 ] channel attention. After convolution, a global average pooling layer aggregates the spatial features and a linear layer projects it into a latent embedding z c ​ t ∈ ℝ d z_{ct}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , where d d is the joint feature space dimension.
blocks.zh: 多通道补丁由定制的3D演化编码器处理. 它由4个连续的残余区块[8] 与挤-和-激发(SE)[10] 通道注意力整合而成. 经过演化后,一个全球平均集合层将空间特征聚合在一起,一个线性层将其投射成一个潜伏的嵌入式 z c t ∈ R d ct}\in\ mathbb{R}^{d},其中dd是联合特征空间维度.

blocks.en: Lobe Expert
blocks.zh: 洛贝专家

blocks.en: Bronchoscopy difficulty varies across pulmonary lobes due to anatomical differences in branching depth and orientation. To incorporate this anatomical prior, we encode the lobe identity L L as a categorical variable and map it into a learnable embedding space via an embedding layer followed by a two-layer MLP: z l ​ o ​ b ​ e = MLP ​ ( Ψ ⁡ ( L ) ) , z l ​ o ​ b ​ e ∈ ℝ d . z_{lobe}=\text{MLP}(\Psi(L)),z_{lobe}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}. This embedding serves as a global anatomical prior that regularizes the final decision. By encoding lobe identity as a continuous representation, the model can learn structured similarities between lobes rather than treating them as independent categories.
blocks.zh: 由于分支深度和方向的解剖差异,各肺叶的溴化物检查难度不同. 为了将这个解剖学的前身,我们将叶片身份L L 编码为绝对变量,并通过嵌入层绘制成可学习的嵌入空间:z l o b e = MLP (Ψ ⁡ (L)),z l o b e ∈ R d. zlobe}=\ text{MLP} (\Psi (L)),z_{lobe}\in\ mathbb{R}^{d}。 这种嵌入是全球解剖法,使最后决定正规化。 通过编码叶片身份作为连续的表示,模型可以学习叶片之间的结构相似性,而不是把它们作为独立的类别对待.

blocks.en: Path Geometry Expert
blocks.zh: 路径几何专家

blocks.en: Accessibility is constrained by cumulative geometric resistance along the airway trajectory from the trachea to the target region. These constraints are sequential and longitudinal in nature, which motivates explicit modeling of the airway trajectory. While the airway tree is naturally a graph, once the navigation path is selected, the data along it forms a one-dimensional ordered sequence of geometric descriptors; we therefore adopt a sequence model rather than a graph neural network. We represent the airway tree as a graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} derived from the segmented airway and extract the candidate navigation path toward the lesion. For cases with multiple plausible routes, the path with the minimal Euclidean distance to the lesion centroid is selected. Nodes along this path are ordered according to anatomical generation to form a proximal-to-distal sequence. To ensure robustness to segmentation noise, we retain only the largest connected component and remove edges shorter than a predefined physical threshold.
blocks.zh: 从气管到目标区域的气道轨迹沿线的累积几何阻力限制了无障碍性。 这些限制是相继的和纵向的,促使对航道轨迹进行明确的模拟。 虽然气道树自然是一种图,但一旦选择了导航路径,其沿线的数据就形成了一维有序的几何描述符序列;因此我们采用了序列模型而不是图神经网络. 我们代表气路树为图G\mathcal{G}, 对于有多种可能路径的病例,选择了欧洲与损伤中心行星最小距离的路径. 沿着这条路径的节点按照解剖学的生成命令形成一个近亲到死序. 为了保证分解噪声的坚固性,我们只保留最大的连接组件,并去除比预先确定的物理阈值短的边缘.

blocks.en: At each node, we compute a set of geometric and topological descriptors, including airway diameter, branching index, curvature, torsion, and relative path length. The ordered feature sequence forms a representation S = { 𝐬 1 , … , 𝐬 T } S=\{\mathbf{s}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{s}_{T}\} , where T T differs across patients depending on airway depth.
blocks.zh: 在每一个节点,我们计算出一组几何和地形描述符,包括气道直径,分支指数,曲率,躯干,以及相对路径长度. 命令的特征序列形成一个表示S={s 1,...,s T } S=\{\mathbf{s}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{s}_{T}\}},其中TT因气道深度不同而不同患者不同.

blocks.en: To model longitudinal constraints, we apply a 1-layer bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) [ 4 ] over the sequence. The GRU is configured with a hidden size of 128 per direction. The final hidden states from both directions are concatenated and then projected to the joint feature space to obtain a path representation z p ​ a ​ t ​ h z_{path} . By explicitly modeling the airway as a sequence, this expert captures progressive narrowing, branching accumulation, and distal complexity. This design provides the framework with a topological understanding of accessibility that is complementary to the visual patterns captured by the CT Expert.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟纵向限制,我们采用1级双向GRU(GRU)[4]的频率单位。 GRU的配置为每个方向的隐藏尺寸128. 最后两个方向的隐藏状态被调和,然后投射到联合特征空间,以获得路径代表z p a t h z_{path}. 通过明确模拟气道作为一个序列,这位专家捕捉到逐渐缩小,分支积累,以及暗淡的复杂性. 这种设计为框架提供了对无障碍的地形理解,补充了CT专家所捕获的视觉模式.

blocks.en: 2.2 Anatomy-Aware Adaptive Expert Fusion
blocks.zh: 2.2 解剖学-智能适应性专家融合

blocks.en: To handle cross-case heterogeneity, we employ an adaptive mixture-of-experts fusion. A gating network assigns importance weights 𝐰 = [ w c ​ t , w l ​ o ​ b ​ e , w p ​ a ​ t ​ h ] ⊤ \mathbf{w}=[w_{ct},w_{lobe},w_{path}]^{\top} to calculate the final fused representation Z = ∑ w i ​ z i Z=\sum w_{i}z_{i} . The gating network conditions on case-level anatomical context: target lesion position p p , lobe embedding Ψ ⁡ ( L ) \Psi(L) , and graph-level airway statistics g g , producing weights via w = Softmax ⁡ ( M ​ L ​ P ​ ( [ p ; Ψ ⁡ ( L ) ; g ] ) ) w=\mathrm{Softmax}(MLP([p;\Psi(L);g])) . It is implemented as a three-layer MLP with ReLU activations and a final Softmax layer. The fused representation Z Z is then passed through a classification head to produce the probability of bronchoscopy accessibility y ^ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \hat{y}\in[0,1] . The entire system is trained using the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss ℒ b ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{bce} . To encourage balanced expert utilization, we add an entropy regularization term on the gating weights: ℒ e ​ n ​ t = − 1 M ∑ i = 1 M ∑ j ∈ { c ​ t , l ​ o ​ b ​ e , p ​ a ​ t ​ h } w i , j log ( w i , j + ϵ ) , \mathcal{L}_{ent}=-\frac{1}{M}\sum_{i=1}^{M}\sum_{j\in\{ct,lobe,path\}}w_{i,j}\log(w_{i,j}+\epsilon), (1) where M M denotes the number of samples and ϵ \epsilon is a small constant for numerical stability. We encourage higher entropy in the gating distribution to avoid degenerate solutions where a single expert dominates across all cases. The total training loss ℒ t ​ o ​ t ​ a ​ l \mathcal{L}_{total} is formulated as: ℒ t ​ o ​ t ​ a ​ l = ℒ b ​ c ​ e − λ ​ ℒ e ​ n ​ t , \mathcal{L}_{total}=\mathcal{L}_{bce}-\lambda\mathcal{L}_{ent}, where λ \lambda is a hyperparameter controlling the regularization strength.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: To fully evaluate the proposed framework, we curated a retrospective multi-center cohort consisting of 438 patients who underwent bronchoscopy for lung lesions. The dataset comprises cases from three clinical centers, including 279 successful procedures and 159 failed attempts. A procedure is labeled successful when diagnostic tissue is confirmed by histopathological analysis of the biopsy sample, which is an objective outcome based on diagnostic yield. Accessibility labels are derived from documented clinical outcomes. All procedures were performed using the same platform to ensure consistency in primary navigation technology across cases. To our knowledge, this is currently the largest dataset reported for outcome-driven bronchoscopy accessibility prediction. The dataset also involves multiple operators and varying device configurations. Although these procedural factors were not explicitly modeled, the multi-center design introduces heterogeneity that reduces systematic bias from a single operator or device type. To ensure robust evaluation, we employ 5-fold cross-validation with patient-level splits.
blocks.zh: 为了充分评价拟议框架,我们为438名接受支气管切片检查的肺损伤患者安排了一个复古多中心组别。 数据集包括三个临床中心的病例,包括279个成功程序和159次失败尝试。 如果对活检样本进行组织病理学分析,确认诊断组织,则将一种程序贴上成功标签,这是基于诊断产量的客观结果。 无障碍标签来源于记录的临床结果. 所有程序都使用同一平台进行,以确保各案件主要导航技术的一致性。 据我们所知,这是目前报告的用于结果驱动的支气管扫描存取预测的最大数据集。 数据集还涉及多个运算符和不同的设备配置. 虽然这些程序因素没有明确的模型化,但多中心设计引入了异质性,减少了单个操作员或设备类型的系统性偏差. 为了保证有力的评价,我们采用5倍的跨验证,与病人的分级。

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementations and Compared Methods
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行情况和比较方法

blocks.en:
For the CT Expert, 3D patches of 128 × 128 × 32 128\times 128\times 32 are extracted around the target lesion. Intensity values were clipped to the lung window range and normalized. We used RetinaNet [ 1 , 3 , 14 ] for lung lesion detection and Naviairway [ 23 ] for airway segmentation. All models are trained using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , batch size 16, and 100 epochs on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. To provide clinical context, 22 clinicians independently assessed accessibility from CT volumes and target locations. Three-level difficulty ratings were mapped to probabilistic scores (0.9, 0.7, 0.4) to compute AUROC and PRAUC. The coefficient λ \lambda is set to 0.01. Dropout and weight decay were used during training to prevent overfitting.
We compare against conventional machine learning models trained on handcrafted geometric descriptors, CT-based deep networks (ResNet-18 [ 8 ] , DenseNet-121 [ 11 ] , EfficientNet-b0 [ 21 ] , ConvNeXt [ 16 ] , and Swin Transformer [ 15 ] ), and graph neural networks (GCN [ 13 ] , GAT [ 22 ] , GIN [ 24 ] , and GraphSAGE [ 7 ] ) operating on airway topology.
blocks.zh:
对于CT专家来说,在目标损伤周围提取了128×128×32128\时的3D补丁. 强度值被剪切到肺窗范围,并正常化。 我们用RetinaNet [1,3,14] 来检测肺部损伤 和Naviairway [23] 来分割空气。 所有型号都使用AdamW进行训练,学习率为1×10−3 1\times 10×3},批量尺寸为16,在NVIDIA A100 GPU上的100个纪元. 为了提供临床环境,22名临床医生从CT卷和目标地点独立评估了无障碍环境。 三级难度评分被映射为概率分数(0.9,0.7,0.4)来计算AUROC和PRAUC. 系数 QQ\lambda 设定为 0.01。 在培训期间使用了辍学和体重衰减,以防止过度调整。
我们比较了在手工几何描述器、基于CT的深层网络(ResNet-18 [8]、DenseNet-121 [11]、高效网-b0 [21]、ConvNEXt [16]和Swin Transformer [15])以及图表神经网络(GCN [13]、GAT [22]、GIN [24]和GraphSAGE [7])上培训的常规机器学习模型。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 量化结果

blocks.en: Comparison with Diverse Baselines
blocks.zh: 与不同基线的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the overall comparison across various methods. Conventional machine learning models trained solely on handcrafted geometric features show limited discriminative ability. CT-based deep networks achieve moderate performance, with the best AUROC reaching 0.6333. Graph neural networks slightly improve structural modeling, achieving up to 0.6483 AUROC. Human experts achieve an AUROC of 0.5661, indicating that visual CT inspection alone is insufficient for reliable accessibility estimation.
blocks.zh: 表1列出各种方法的总体比较情况。 仅接受手工几何特征培训的常规机器学习模型显示,歧视能力有限。 基于CT的深层网络实现适度性能,最好的AUROC达到0.6333. 图形神经网络略微改进结构模型,达到0.6483 AUROC. 人类专家的AUROC为0.5661,表明光是视觉CT检查不足以可靠地估计无障碍性。

blocks.en: The proposed anatomy-aware mixture-of-experts model achieves an AUROC of 0.8052 and PR-AUC of 0.8496, significantly outperforming computational baselines and human assessment. These results demonstrate the benefit of explicitly integrating airway trajectory modeling with local imaging cues. Importantly, the proposed model maintains competitive computational efficiency. With 3.83M parameters, it is more lightweight than most CT-based backbone networks while achieving superior predictive performance. This efficiency supports potential integration into pre-procedural planning workflows.
blocks.zh: 拟议的解剖学-认识专家混合模型的AUROC为0.8052,PR-AUC为0.8496,大大超过计算基线和人类评估。 这些结果表明,明确将航道轨迹建模与当地成像提示相结合是有益的。 重要的是,拟议模式保持竞争性计算效率。 拥有3.83M参数,比大多数基于CT的骨干网络更轻量级,同时实现优异的预测性能. 这种效率支持可能融入程序前的规划工作流程。

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance comparison of the proposed method against various baseline models. Human assessments were provided by 22 clinicians based on CT volumes and target lesion locations. † indicates statistically significant difference compared with the proposed method (DeLong test, p < 0.05).
blocks.zh: 表1:拟议方法与各种基准模型的绩效比较。 22名临床医生根据CT卷和目标损伤地点进行了人类评估。 ++表示与拟议方法相比在统计上存在显著差异(DeLong测试,p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: Comparison Under Identical CT Inputs
blocks.zh: 在相同CT输入下进行比较

blocks.en: To ensure that the performance gain does not arise from richer input representations alone, Table 2 compares our model with CT-based deep networks trained on identical multi-channel inputs, including CT intensity, airway distance maps, and lesion masks. Even under this controlled setting, our model maintains a clear advantage. The strongest CNN baseline achieves 0.7310 AUROC, while the proposed method reaches 0.8052 AUROC. This result indicates that architectural decomposition and adaptive expert fusion account for the performance improvement rather than input augmentation alone.
blocks.zh: 为了保证性能收益不会仅仅来自丰富的输入表示,表2将我们的模型与基于CT的深层网络进行比较,这些网络受过相同的多通道输入的培训,包括CT强度,航道距离图,以及损伤口罩. 即使在这种受控环境下,我们的模型也保持明显的优势. CNN最强基线达到0.7310 AUROC,而拟议方法达到0.8052 AUROC. 这一结果表明,建筑分解和适应性专家聚变是业绩改进的原因,而不只是投入增强。

blocks.en: Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates the contribution of each expert and their combinations. Among single branches, the CT Expert achieves the strongest performance (AUROC 0.7382), confirming that local volumetric context provides a solid baseline. The Path Geometry Expert (0.6040 AUROC) captures meaningful structural constraints along the airway trajectory but remains insufficient alone. The Lobe Expert performs near chance level (0.5513 AUROC), consistent with its role as a global anatomical prior rather than a standalone predictor.
blocks.zh: 表3评估了每位专家的贡献及其组合。 在单个分支中,CT专家取得了最强的性能(AUROC 0.7382),证实本地量学背景提供了坚实的基线. 路径几何专家(0.6040 AUROC)掌握了沿航道轨迹的有意义的结构制约因素,但单靠它是不够的。 Lobe专家的成绩接近机会水平(0.5513 AUROC),符合其作为全球解剖学先导而非独立预测者的作用。

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparison with CT-based deep networks trained using multi-channel volumetric inputs (CT intensity, airway distance transform, and lesion mask). † indicates statistically significant difference compared with the proposed method (DeLong test, p < 0.05).
blocks.zh: 表2:与使用多通道体积输入(CT强度、航道距离变换和损伤口罩)培训的基于CT的深层网络的比较。 ++表示与拟议方法相比在统计上存在显著差异(DeLong测试,p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: Pairwise combinations consistently improve over individual modules. Combining CT and Path Experts increases AUROC to 0.7756, demonstrating the complementary effect of trajectory modeling. The full model integrating all three experts achieves the best performance (0.8052 AUROC). We also observe that CT Expert receives higher weights for centrally located lesions, while Path Geometry Expert weights increase for distal and lower-lobe lesions, suggesting anatomically consistent specialization. The gating weights, 𝐰 = [ w c ​ t , w l ​ o ​ b ​ e , w p ​ a ​ t ​ h ] ⊤ \mathbf{w}=[w_{ct},w_{lobe},w_{path}]^{\top} , thus provide a built-in case-level attribution: for any prediction, 𝐰 \mathbf{w} indicates which anatomical factor drives the decision, offering interpretability without requiring post-hoc explanation methods. These results indicate that bronchoscopy accessibility depends on the joint modeling of local morphology, anatomical context, and cumulative airway geometry rather than any single modality alone.
blocks.zh: 对等组合比单个模块不断改进。 结合CT和路径专家将AUROC增加到0.7756,证明了轨迹模型的互补作用. 融合所有三位专家的完整模式取得了最佳业绩(0.8052 AUROC)。 我们还注意到,CT专家对位于中心位置的损伤的权重较高,而Path Geometry专家对Distal和低地损伤的权重增加,这表明在解剖学上始终保持专业化。 w = [w c t, w l o b e, w a t h] =\ mathbf{w} [w_{ct}, w_{lobe}, w_{path}} =^{\top}),因此提供了内置的例级归属: 对于任何预测, w mathbf{w} 表示哪个解剖因子驱动决定,提供可解释性而不需要事后解释方法. 这些结果显示,支气管镜学的可获取性取决于局部形态学,解剖学背景和累积气道几何学的联合模型,而不是任何单一模式的单独.

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study evaluating the contribution of each expert module. The full model integrates all experts through adaptive gating.
blocks.zh: 表3:评估每个专家单元的贡献的关联研究。 完整的模型通过适应性定位融合了所有专家.

blocks.en: 4.2 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 定性分析

blocks.en: To further illustrate model behavior, Fig. 2 presents representative cases of true positive, false positive, false negative, and true negative predictions. The red marker indicates the target lesion location, and the airway tree is rendered to visualize the navigational trajectory.
blocks.zh: 为进一步说明模型行为,图2给出了真实的阳性,假阳性,假阴性,真实的阴性预测等有代表性的案例. 红色标记表示目标损伤位置,气道树被渲染成可视化导航轨迹.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Representative qualitative examples illustrating true positive (TP), false positive (FP), false negative (FN), and true negative (TN) predictions. Airway trees are visualized together with target lesion locations (red markers).
blocks.zh: 图 2: 具有代表性的定性例子,说明真实的阳性(TP)、虚假的阳性(FP)、虚假的阴性(FN)和真实的阴性(TN)预测。 空中树木与目标损伤地点(红色标记)一起可视化.

blocks.en: The true positive case shows a lesion near a well-connected airway branch with sufficient diameter. The false positive case shows a lesion anatomically close to the distal bronchi but with abrupt branching changes along the path, where the CT Expert may overweight local proximity in such cases. The false negative involves a peripheral lesion with limited distal branches, where successful sampling may still occur in practice due to operator expertise or ultra-thin bronchoscopes. The true negative shows a deeply peripheral lesion with sparse connectivity. Overall, accessibility depends on both local lesion–airway adjacency and cumulative geometric constraints; clinical execution factors beyond static anatomy also influence outcomes.
blocks.zh: 真正的阳性病例显示,一个连接良好的直径足够大的气道分支附近有损伤. 假阳性病例表明,在解剖学上,有一处损伤接近断裂的青铜器,但沿途突然发生分枝变化,在这种情况下,CT专家可能会超重地接近当地。 假阴性涉及边缘损伤,分枝有限,由于操作员的专业知识或超深的支气管,在实际操作中仍有可能成功取样。 真实的负值显示,由于连通性极差,造成非常严重的边缘损伤。 总体而言,无障碍性既取决于局部损伤-航道的连带性,也取决于累积的几何限制;静态解剖学以外的临床执行因素也会影响结果.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a supervised learning problem and to benchmark it against both computational baselines and human expert assessment. The results reveal that this clinically relevant task remains under-explored and difficult under conventional visual evaluation paradigms.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是将支气管镜学无障碍性预测系统化成一个受监督的学习问题并参照计算基线和人类专家评估加以衡量的第一次研究。 结果显示,在传统视觉评价范式下,这项临床相关任务仍然未得到充分探讨和困难。

blocks.en: We presented the first learning-based framework for predicting bronchoscopy accessibility directly from pre-procedural CT. The proposed anatomy-aware mixture-of-experts model decomposes accessibility prediction into complementary components. It integrates local volumetric context, global anatomical priors, and sequential airway path geometry within a unified end-to-end architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了第一个基于学习的框架,用于直接从程序前的CT中预测支气管扫描的可获取性。 拟议的解剖学-意识混合专家模型将无障碍预测分解为互补成分. 它融合了局部的卷状上下文,全球解剖学前科,以及统一端对端架构内的顺序气道路径几何.

blocks.en: The experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art single-modality baselines and experienced human experts. Notably, the model achieves these gains with a lightweight architecture, maintaining low parameter count and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 实验结果表明,我们的做法大大超过了最先进的单一模式基线和经验丰富的人类专家。 值得注意的是,该模型以轻量级架构实现这些收益,保持低参数计数和计算成本.

blocks.en: By bridging airway topology and functional procedural outcome prediction, this work moves beyond connectivity analysis toward quantitative accessibility assessment. We anticipate that such anatomy-aware modeling may support pre-procedural planning and improve patient selection in bronchoscopy-guided diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 通过连接空中地形和功能性程序结果预测,这项工作超越了连通性分析,转向定量无障碍评估。 我们预计,这种解剖意识模型可能支持程序前规划,并改善在支气管镜学指导诊断中的病人选择。
